reviews.text:
I've left my cat, Jolie, at Motelamatou several times and I highly recommend them! Fabienne Champarnaud gives a warm welcome and genuinely cares for each of her feline guests. The place is impeccably clean, the cats' "apartments" are spacious, and so on... It gives us, the owners of our companions, complete peace of mind. Jolie has never had any problems, either during or after her stay at Motelamatou. Another important point: excellent value for money, and Ms. Champarnaud provides updates on her guests during their stay, which is very reassuring for owners when they're away. She's also available 24/7 for the guests, which is very important to me personally. I'd like to add: Fabienne took care of my cat for almost a month during that heatwave in Paris when my apartment was a veritable oven… I was worried about my cat, who was suffering terribly, and without Fabienne, I don't know where we'd be today… Thank you, thank you so much, dear Fabienne, from Jolie and me… 🙏🙏🙏
Deirdre Jeffers

Hesitant to entrust my cat to someone else, I asked my vet for boarding recommendations. She suggested Motelamatou. The name made me smile, and then I took the plunge. Two stays: one for a week at Christmas and then 16 days in May. Fabienne's welcome is very warm, gentle, and reassuring. Hygiene is paramount. The cats can see each other, so the presence of other animals is essential. My cat came back with a valuable experience. He wasn't upset that we left him there. Motelamatou is a real lifesaver for cat lovers like me.
Fabienne is extraordinary, I highly recommend her. I've been coming for 5 years with my Siamese cat, who always comes back very happy from his stays at Motelamatou.

I've known Motelamatou for over 20 years. Fabienne runs her cat boarding facility with a master's touch! You can leave your pet there with complete peace of mind.

What's reassuring is that she makes a point of prioritizing the hygiene and safety of our feline friends. They aren't mixed together, so there's no risk of altercations; they go outside in shifts; their diet is strictly followed; the common areas as well as the individual enclosures are cleaned and disinfected daily... and of course, Fabienne doesn't forget the cuddles and playtime in her lovely space with her little guests several times a day. I highly recommend this unique boarding facility in Paris. My little cat just finished his summer stay; he's back home looking beautiful and thriving ❤️
Well done, Fabienne!
Fabienne is a passionate cat therapist. She took care of our Bengal Harlem for 10 days, and I'm very grateful. Patient, gentle, and pleasant, she'll put you at ease.

I 300% recommend this cat hotel. I entrusted Nestor to Fabienne for three weeks. I found my cat in perfect health and I no longer have any worries about going on vacation without my little feline. Go for it without hesitation! Thank you, Fabienne, for your love of cats.
My cat has been spending her holidays at MOTELAMATOU for the past three years. Everything goes well! I am satisfied and have complete confidence in Fabienne, our hostess.

Second stay for my cat.

Everything was perfect.
Thanks again, Fabienne.

I've entrusted Azam to your care for four years now. Despite the stress of separation, I've always received my pet back in a very relaxed state.
Thank you for your work and dedication.

Sahara has been welcomed by Mrs. Champarnaud at Motelamatou for several years now, with gentleness and kindness, and with respect for hygiene standards and the individual personality of each cat. I always pick up Sahara rested and in good spirits, as if she had never left home! Thank you for your impeccable care.

A 5-star cattery that my cat Simba has stayed at twice. Spacious and spotlessly clean facilities. Very professional service.
I highly recommend this type of boarding.

My son Fifi was very happy with his welcome and his stay at Motelamatou. The rooms are very pleasant and impeccably clean.

A big thank you to the manager.
We've been leaving our cat at Motelamatou for several years now. We highly recommend this cat boarding facility; everything is perfect!
